summary: @ornikar/renovate-config 9.0.3 preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: This version ships a preinstall hook that is inconsistent with the package's advertised purpose (a static Renovate shared configuration; the README marks the package as deprecated). package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 as a platform-specific zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts the bun binary to a temp path, chmods it executable (0o755), and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB bundle carrying the '// @bun @bun-cjs' header and obfuscator.io fingerprints (hex-named identifiers such as _0x, MmgoCP, etDiOOB; a large mixed hex/string constant array; and a string-array rotator function that shifts the array before lookup). The bundled strings include split/encoded fragments consistent with hidden network destinations. The alternate-runtime download is used to execute an opaque, obfuscated payload on every install under a scope developers trust for Renovate configuration; nothing in a Renovate JSON config requires a foreign interpreter or a compiled JS bundle. The shape is a supply-chain compromise of the @ornikar/renovate-config publish, delivering install-time arbitrary code execution to any project that installs this version.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
